## MobiRig — rig any 3D character in minutes, right on your phone

Drop in a character, place a few dots, and get a fully rigged, animation-ready model. Everything works offline, nothing is uploaded.

### What you can do
- **Rig in a few taps.** Open a 3D character and MobiRig suggests where the head, shoulders, wrists, hips and ankles are. Nudge the dots with a magnifier for precision.
- **Fingers that bend.** Each finger moves on its own, with a natural fist and relaxed hand poses.
- **Test before you export.** Try ready-made poses and animations: Idle, Walk, Run, Jump and Wave.
- **Bring your own animations.** Import a motion from another character and see it play on yours.
- **Paint the skin.** Fine-tune how the body follows each bone with Add, Subtract and Smooth brushes, with left/right mirroring.
- **Export for your favourite engine.** Choose bone names for Mixamo, Unity or Unreal and include the animations in the file.
- **Never lose your work.** Undo and redo marker moves; your markers are restored when you reopen the same model.
- **Made for touch.** Large buttons, hold any icon to see what it does, clean dark design for phone and desktop.

Install the APK below, open a character and tap **Rig it**.
